extraction.Name: Louise Ullman
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want it, but took it on the advise of the Superintendent, but that she brought it back several times and tried to get them to take it back
extraction.Recorded patent: did not have it recorded and does not know who did
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold one, the north one to Douglas Points for $1000.00 and eleven head of horses and the south tract she sold the south Apart tract, in connection with a quarter of inherited land to Harry J. Evans, Pine Ridge, So. Dak. for $6000.00
extraction.Buyer: Douglas Points (north tract, $1000.00 and eleven head of horses); Harry J. Evans, Pine Ridge, South Dakota (south tract and quarter of inherited land, $6000.00)
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: this took all her stock with it, as they were mortgaged
extraction.Occupation/Income: depends on her children and friends for a living
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent and in very poor health; has no home; has no one depending on her for support; has not received any aid from the Government, State or County since her patent was issued; allotment had two tracts; south tract sold together with a quarter of inherited land; stock was mortgaged and went with the south tract sale; affidavit subscribed and sworn before notary public, State of South Dakota, County of Shannon, November 13, 1928
